html:
NomadX provides advanced sanitation technologies designed to help food manufacturers, processors, retailers, and quality teams improve cleaning outcomes, reduce pathogen risks, and address biofilm challenges where traditional chemistries often fall short. 

With an upcoming industry event and a need to engage more food safety decision-makers, NomadX partnered with MarketJoy to create a scalable outreach strategy that would generate qualified conversations before, during, and after the event. 

The Challenge 

NomadX faced a common challenge seen across many specialized B2B organizations: 

  • Event attendance alone does not guarantee meaningful conversations. 
  • Key buyers have busy schedules and limited time at trade shows. 
  • Building targeted prospect lists manually is time-consuming. 
  • Traditional outreach often produces inconsistent results. 
  • Identifying the right quality, sanitation, microbiology, and food safety contacts across multiple industries requires significant research. 

NomadX needed more than an event promotion campaign—they needed a repeatable process capable of continually identifying new prospects and converting them into sales conversations. 

MarketJoy’s Approach

MarketJoy developed a hybrid outreach strategy designed to continuously uncover and engage food safety professionals across multiple sectors.

Building an Expanding Prospect Database

MarketJoy created a targeted database of: Food and beverage manufacturers Restaurants and foodservice organizations Retail quality teams Chemical manufacturers Certification and compliance organizations Food safety consultants Within each organization, MarketJoy identified relevant stakeholders including: Quality Assurance Managers Food Safety Directors Microbiology Supervisors Sanitation Leaders SQF and Regulatory Professionals Operations and Manufacturing Executives Rather than using a static list, the database was continuously expanded throughout the campaign, ensuring NomadX always had access to new opportunities.

Combining Research with Personalized Outreach

MarketJoy used a combination of: Direct calling Email outreach Event-focused messaging Industry research Human-led qualification Every interaction centered around challenges food processors face every day: Biofilm control Sanitation effectiveness Pathogen prevention Equipment compatibility Water system contamination risks Improving outcomes beyond traditional chemistries This allowed NomadX’s message to resonate naturally with quality and food safety professionals.

Converting Awareness into Meetings

MarketJoy did not simply promote booth attendance. The team worked to: Confirm event participation Identify schedules Secure meeting commitments Deliver follow-up communication Create opportunities for walk-up booth visits Generate introductions and referral opportunities Examples of organizations engaged included: The Wendy’s Company Ruiz Foods Costco Wholesale Canteen North America DeVere Company Eagle Certification Group International Product Safety Consultants The result was a steady stream of qualified conversations before and during the event.

Results: Campaign Outcomes

More importantly, the campaign created a repeatable framework for identifying and engaging future prospects beyond a single event. 

Rather than relying on one-time attendee lists, NomadX gained an ongoing process for uncovering new sales opportunities across the food manufacturing ecosystem. 

22 qualified leads generated

Multiple scheduled event meetings

220% of original target achieved

Target of 10 leads exceeded within three months

Additional referral opportunities identified

High-value conversations with food safety and quality leaders

Client Feedback

“Working with MarketJoy has been a great experience. The team exceeded our expectations by delivering 22 qualified leads against an initial target of 10 within just three months. 

Beyond the original outbound campaign, they also supported our event outreach efforts, helping us maximize engagement and create additional opportunities. 

We’ve had several meaningful conversations with the leads generated, and the overall quality has been excellent. 

Throughout the engagement, the MarketJoy team has been responsive, proactive, and genuinely invested in our success. 

We’re very happy with the results and look forward to continuing our partnership.” 

— NomadX

Why It Worked

The success of this campaign came from combining three elements: 

Data

Continuously identifying new companies, contacts, and food safety professionals.

Human Engagement

Using personalized outreach and live conversations to qualify opportunities.

Industry Relevance

Positioning NomadX around real sanitation and food safety challenges rather than generic product messaging.

The result was not simply more leads—it was an ever-scaling pipeline of meaningful sales conversations that NomadX can continue to build upon long after the event concluded. 

About MarketJoy

MarketJoy helps B2B organizations create predictable growth through a combination of: 

  • Outbound lead generation 
  • Targeted database development 
  • AI-enhanced prospect identification 
  • Event outreach campaigns 
  • Human qualification 
  • Sales appointment setting 

By combining data, technology, and human engagement, MarketJoy helps companies consistently uncover and convert new opportunities. 

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What challenge was NomadX trying to solve? 

NomadX wanted to generate more qualified sales opportunities with food safety professionals while maximizing the value of an upcoming industry event. They needed a consistent way to identify the right decision-makers, secure meetings, and create meaningful conversations before, during, and after the event. 

2. Why did NomadX choose MarketJoy? 

MarketJoy offered more than traditional appointment setting. The team developed an ongoing prospecting strategy that continuously identified new companies and contacts while executing personalized outreach through email and phone. This allowed NomadX to build a growing pipeline instead of relying on a one-time event list. 

3. How did MarketJoy identify qualified prospects? 

MarketJoy researched organizations across the food manufacturing ecosystem and identified key decision-makers responsible for food safety, quality assurance, sanitation, microbiology, compliance, and operations. The prospect database was continually expanded throughout the campaign to ensure a steady flow of new opportunities. 

4. What industries were targeted? 

The campaign focused on organizations including: 

  • Food and beverage manufacturers 
  • Restaurant and foodservice companies 
  • Food retailers 
  • Chemical manufacturers 
  • Food safety consulting firms 
  • Certification and compliance organizations 

This allowed NomadX to engage buyers across multiple segments of the food safety industry. 

5. What types of contacts were engaged? 

MarketJoy focused on professionals responsible for sanitation, quality, and food safety, including: 

  • Food Safety Directors 
  • Quality Assurance Managers 
  • Sanitation Managers 
  • Microbiology Leaders 
  • Operations Executives 
  • Regulatory and Compliance Professionals 

6. How was the outreach personalized? 

Every conversation centered on the real challenges these professionals face, including pathogen prevention, biofilm removal, sanitation effectiveness, regulatory compliance, and improving cleaning outcomes. Rather than promoting products, the outreach focused on solving operational problems relevant to each prospect. 

7. Did MarketJoy only support the event? 

No. While event outreach was an important component, MarketJoy also built an ongoing outbound campaign that generated qualified conversations before and after the event. This ensured the campaign continued producing value beyond the trade show itself. 

8. What results did the campaign achieve? 

The campaign generated 22 qualified leads, exceeding the original goal of 10 leads within three months. In addition to qualified meetings, MarketJoy helped create new referral opportunities and meaningful conversations with food safety leaders across the industry. 

9. What made the campaign successful? 

Three key factors contributed to the results: 

  • Continuous expansion of targeted prospect lists 
  • Personalized human outreach through phone and email 
  • Messaging focused on the business challenges prospects were already trying to solve 

Together, these elements created a repeatable system for generating high-quality sales opportunities. 

10. How did the client describe the engagement? 

NomadX shared the following feedback: 

“Working with MarketJoy has been a great experience. The team exceeded our expectations by delivering 22 qualified leads against an initial target of 10 within just three months. Beyond the original outbound campaign, they also supported our event outreach efforts, helping us maximize engagement and create additional opportunities. We’ve had several meaningful conversations with the leads generated, and the overall quality has been excellent. Throughout the engagement, the MarketJoy team has been responsive, proactive, and genuinely invested in our success. We’re very happy with the results and look forward to continuing our partnership.” 

11. What differentiates MarketJoy from traditional lead generation companies? 

Instead of purchasing static lists or relying on automated outreach alone, MarketJoy combines ongoing prospect research, human-led qualification, personalized messaging, and multi-channel engagement to create a continually growing pipeline of qualified sales opportunities. 

12. Can this approach work for companies outside the food safety industry? 

Yes. While this campaign focused on food safety and sanitation, MarketJoy’s methodology is industry-agnostic. The same process of identifying ideal buyers, expanding targeted prospect lists, personalizing outreach, and qualifying opportunities can be applied across manufacturing, software, healthcare, logistics, professional services, and many other B2B industries. 

13. What is the biggest takeaway from the NomadX campaign? 

The campaign demonstrated that successful outbound marketing is more than scheduling meetings—it’s about building a scalable, repeatable system for identifying new prospects, engaging the right decision-makers, and consistently generating qualified sales conversations that support long-term growth.
